### 2. Enterprise Wireless & Networking Solutions

- Cisco Solutions — enterprise routers, switches, firewalls, collaboration
- Juniper Solutions — enterprise networking and security

### 3. Physical Security & Surveillance

### 4. Infrastructure & Cabling

### 5. Cloud & Managed IT Services
- Cloud Solutions — AWS, Azure, Google Cloud deployment
- Cloud Infrastructure — servers, storage, backup, disaster recovery
- VPN Solutions — site-to-site, remote access VPN
- Data Center Solutions — co-location, private cloud
- Managed IT Services — proactive 24/7 monitoring and management

### 6. Cybersecurity

### 7. Website Development
